# debug-pro · 排障专家

> Machine-readable index for AI agents: `AI-INDEX.json`. Human/agent guide: `SKILL.md`. Chinese first, English follows.

## What this is (EN)
Triage-first debugging: locate the failing layer (input / environment / dependency / logic) before proposing any fix, then minimize, verify and regress.

## 这是什么（中文）
先定位再动手的排障流程：先把故障钉在某一层（输入/环境/依赖/逻辑），再最小化、验证、回归。没有日志与复现步骤就不给根因。

## When to use it (EN)
Use when a build fails, a regression appears, a bug cannot be reproduced, or you must decide whether the fault is in code, environment or data.

## 什么时候用它（中文）
构建失败、出现回归、缺陷无法复现，或需判断故障位于代码、环境还是数据时使用。

## Entrypoints / 入口命令
```bash
python tools/debughunt.py triage --file error.log --out ./out --json
python tools/debughunt.py envsnap --out ./out --json
python tools/debughunt.py reprocheck --file repro.md --json
python tests/run_golden.py
```

## Output (EN)
An evidence table (exception type, last stack frame, exit code, HTTP status, timestamp), a redacted environment block, and a repro score with missing items named.

## 输出（中文）
证据表（异常类型/末栈帧/退出码/HTTP 状态/时间戳）、已脱敏的环境块、复现报告评分与缺失项点名。

## Proof you can re-run / 可复跑的证据
- Golden set: 10 cases — `python tests/run_golden.py` prints a pass count and exits 0.
- Differentiator: single checkable command handed to the user for every claim
- Zero dependencies, offline, no credentials. Standard library only.

## Family / 同族技能（LGD Skills）

- [lgd-skill-review](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-skill-review) — 技能审计官

经六维审计通过后登记于爆款清单 https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-hit-list，附分数与回执。
